<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Kholik Nugraha — Portofolio</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;600;700;900&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  :root {
    --ink: #1a1a2e;
    --gold: #c9a84c;
    --gold-light: #e8c97a;
    --cream: #f9f5ee;
    --paper: #fff8ef;
    --muted: #7a6e5f;
    --line: #e0d5c5;
    --accent: #2d5a87;
  }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    background: var(--cream);
    color: var(--ink);
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* ── NAV ── */
  nav {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 1.2rem 3rem;
    background: rgba(249,245,238,0.92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav-logo {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--ink);
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }
  .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2rem; list-style: none; }
  .nav-links a {
    font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--gold); }

  /* ── HERO ── */
  .hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    padding-top: 80px;
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .hero-bg {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 70% 50%, rgba(201,168,76,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 60% at 20% 80%, rgba(45,90,135,0.06) 0%, transparent 60%);
  }
  .hero-pattern {
    position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 50%;
    background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
      0deg, transparent, transparent 39px, var(--line) 39px, var(--line) 40px
    ),
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      90deg, transparent, transparent 39px, var(--line) 39px, var(--line) 40px
    );
    opacity: 0.3;
  }
  .hero-left {
    padding: 6rem 3rem 4rem 5rem;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
    position: relative; z-index: 2;
  }
  .hero-tag {
    display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold);
    padding: 0.4rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius: 2px;
  }
  .hero-name {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 5vw, 4.2rem);
    font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.08;
    color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
  .hero-name span { color: var(--gold); }
  .hero-role {
    font-size: 1rem; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; max-width: 420px;
  }
  .hero-contact {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--muted);
  }
  .hero-contact span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
  .hero-contact svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; opacity: 0.6; }
  .hero-cta {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
    margin-top: 2rem; padding: 0.85rem 2rem;
    background: var(--ink); color: var(--cream);
    font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none;
    border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s;
    width: fit-content;
  }
  .hero-cta:hover { background: var(--gold); color: var(--ink); }

  .hero-right {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    position: relative; z-index: 2; padding: 4rem 4rem 4rem 2rem;
  }
  .photo-frame {
    position: relative; width: 340px; height: 420px;
  }
  .photo-frame::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute; top: 16px; left: 16px;
    right: -16px; bottom: -16px;
    border: 2px solid var(--gold); border-radius: 2px;
    z-index: 0;
  }
  .photo-inner {
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d4c4a8 0%, #b8a890 100%);
    border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }
  .photo-inner img {
    width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;
  }
  .photo-placeholder {
    text-align: center; color: #8a7a6a;
  }
  .photo-placeholder svg { width: 64px; height: 64px; opacity: 0.4; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
  .photo-placeholder p { font-size: 0.8rem; opacity: 0.6; }
  .photo-badge {
    position: absolute; bottom: -16px; right: -16px; z-index: 2;
    background: var(--gold); color: var(--ink);
    padding: 0.8rem 1.2rem;
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; text-align: center;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  /* ── SECTIONS ── */
  section { padding: 6rem 5rem; }
  section:nth-child(even) { background: var(--paper); }

  .section-label {
    font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 0.8rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem;
  }
  .section-label::after {
    content: ''; flex: 1; max-width: 40px;
    height: 1px; background: var(--gold);
  }
  .section-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.6rem);
    font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink);
    margin-bottom: 3rem; line-height: 1.2;
  }

  /* ── ABOUT ── */
  .about-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4rem; align-items: start; }
  .about-text p {
    font-size: 1.02rem; line-height: 1.85; color: #3a3328;
    margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  }
  .about-text p strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }
  .stats-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; }
  .stat-card {
    background: var(--cream); border: 1px solid var(--line);
    padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 2px;
  }
  .stat-number {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gold);
    display: block; margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
  }
  .stat-label { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }

  /* ── EXPERIENCE ── */
  .experience-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }
  .exp-item {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 140px 1fr;
    gap: 2rem; padding: 2.5rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0);
    transition: opacity 0.5s, transform 0.5s;
  }
  .exp-date {
    font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted);
    letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding-top: 0.25rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .exp-content {}
  .exp-tag {
    display: inline-block; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent); background: rgba(45,90,135,0.08);
    padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 2px; margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  }
  .exp-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink);
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
  }
  .exp-org { font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--gold); font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 0.8rem; }
  .exp-desc { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.7; }
  .exp-desc ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; }
  .exp-desc ul li::before { content: '→  '; color: var(--gold); font-weight: 600; }

  /* ── SKILLS ── */
  .skills-wrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3rem; }
  .skill-group-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink);
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem; padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .skill-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
  .skill-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; }
  .skill-name { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
  .skill-name span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.78rem; }
  .skill-bar {
    height: 4px; background: var(--line); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .skill-fill {
    height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-light));
    border-radius: 2px; width: 0; transition: width 1s ease;
  }

  .lang-cards { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
  .lang-card {
    background: var(--cream); border: 1px solid var(--line);
    padding: 1.2rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 2px;
  }
  .lang-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
  .lang-score { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--gold); font-weight: 600; }
  .lang-detail { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 0.3rem; }

  /* ── ACHIEVEMENTS ── */
  .achieve-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 1.5rem; }
  .achieve-card {
    background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line);
    padding: 2rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 2px;
    transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
  }
  .achieve-card:hover { border-color: var(--gold); transform: translateY(-3px); }
  .achieve-icon { font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .achieve-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
  }
  .achieve-org { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--gold); font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
  .achieve-desc { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.6; }

  /* ── CONTACT ── */
  .contact-inner {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4rem; align-items: center;
  }
  .contact-text p { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .contact-links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
  .contact-link {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem;
    padding: 1rem 1.5rem; background: var(--cream);
    border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 2px;
    text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink);
    transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
  }
  .contact-link:hover { border-color: var(--gold); background: rgba(201,168,76,0.05); }
  .contact-link-icon { font-size: 1.1rem; width: 20px; text-align: center; }
  .contact-link-text { font-size: 0.88rem; }
  .contact-link-label { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--muted); display: block; }

  /* ── FOOTER ── */
  footer {
    padding: 2rem 5rem; background: var(--ink); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    font-size: 0.78rem; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  }
  footer span { color: var(--gold); }

  /* ── ANIMATIONS ── */
  .fade-in {
    opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px);
    animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease forwards;
  }
  @keyframes fadeUp {
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }
  .delay-1 { animation-delay: 0.15s; }
  .delay-2 { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
  .delay-3 { animation-delay: 0.45s; }
  .delay-4 { animation-delay: 0.6s; }

  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    nav { padding: 1rem 1.5rem; }
    .nav-links { display: none; }
    .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; }
    .hero-left { padding: 6rem 2rem 2rem; }
    .hero-right { display: none; }
    section { padding: 4rem 2rem; }
    .about-grid, .skills-wrap, .contact-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .achieve-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .exp-item { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0.5rem; }
    footer { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1.5rem 2rem; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav>
  <div class="nav-logo">Kholik Nugraha</div>
  <ul class="nav-links">
    <li><a href="#tentang">Tentang</a></li>
    <li><a href="#pengalaman">Pengalaman</a></li>
    <li><a href="#kemampuan">Kemampuan</a></li>
    <li><a href="#penghargaan">Penghargaan</a></li>
    <li><a href="#kontak">Kontak</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>

<!-- HERO -->
<section class="hero" id="home">
  <div class="hero-bg"></div>
  <div class="hero-pattern"></div>
  <div class="hero-left">
    <div class="hero-tag fade-in">Portofolio Profesional</div>
    <h1 class="hero-name fade-in delay-1">Kholik<br><span>Nugraha</span></h1>
    <p class="hero-role fade-in delay-2">
      Mahasiswa Sejarah dan Peradaban Islam dengan pengalaman di bidang 
      administrasi pemerintahan, koordinasi organisasi, dan pemberdayaan sosial budaya.
    </p>
    <div class="hero-contact fade-in delay-3">
      <span>
        <svg fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M17.657 16.657L13.414 20.9a1.998 1.998 0 01-2.827 0l-4.244-4.243a8 8 0 1111.314 0z"/><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 11a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"/></svg>
        Kab. Karawang, Jawa Barat
      </span>
      <span>
        <svg fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M3 8l7.89 5.26a2 2 0 002.22 0L21 8M5 19h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2z"/></svg>
        kholiknugraha732@gmail.com
      </span>
      <span>
        <svg fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M3 5a2 2 0 012-2h3.28a1 1 0 01.948.684l1.498 4.493a1 1 0 01-.502 1.21l-2.257 1.13a11.042 11.042 0 005.516 5.516l1.13-2.257a1 1 0 011.21-.502l4.493 1.498a1 1 0 01.684.948V19a2 2 0 01-2 2h-1C9.716 21 3 14.284 3 7V5z"/></svg>
        +62 895 3394 86833
      </span>
    </div>
    <a href="#kontak" class="hero-cta fade-in delay-4">
      Hubungi Saya
      <svg width="14" height="14" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M17 8l4 4m0 0l-4 4m4-4H3"/></svg>
    </a>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-right fade-in delay-2">
    <div class="photo-frame">
      <div class="photo-inner" id="photoInner">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Kholik Nugraha" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;">
      </div>
      <div class="photo-badge">IPK<br>3,38</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- TENTANG -->
<section id="tentang">
  <div class="section-label">Tentang Saya</div>
  <h2 class="section-title">Latar Belakang &<br>Motivasi</h2>
  <div class="about-grid">
    <div class="about-text">
      <p>
        Saya adalah lulusan <strong>Sejarah dan Peradaban Islam, UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta</strong>, 
        dengan IPK 3,38 dan rekam jejak aktif di dunia organisasi serta pelayanan publik. 
        Perjalanan akademik saya membentuk pemahaman mendalam tentang dinamika sosial, 
        budaya, dan kelembagaan — fondasi yang sangat relevan dalam konteks ketenagakerjaan dan kebijakan publik.
      </p>
      <p>
        Pengalaman magang di <strong>Pusat Sejarah TNI – Museum Satria Mandala</strong> 
        memberikan saya wawasan langsung tentang tata kelola administrasi dan dokumentasi institusi negara. 
        Sementara pengalaman sebagai <strong>Surveyor di PT. Pusat Data Riset</strong> mengasah kemampuan 
        pengumpulan dan verifikasi data secara sistematis di lapangan.
      </p>
      <p>
        Di luar akademik, saya aktif memimpin organisasi mahasiswa — mulai dari tingkat 
        program studi hingga organisasi nasional — yang melatih kemampuan 
        <strong>koordinasi, advokasi, dan pengambilan keputusan strategis</strong>.
      </p>
    </div>
    <div class="stats-grid">
      <div class="stat-card">
        <span class="stat-number">3,38</span>
        <span class="stat-label">IPK Akademik</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <span class="stat-number">3+</span>
        <span class="stat-label">Posisi Kepemimpinan</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <span class="stat-number">2</span>
        <span class="stat-label">Beasiswa Prestasi</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <span class="stat-number">2020</span>
        <span class="stat-label">Mulai Pengalaman Kerja</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- PENGALAMAN -->
<section id="pengalaman">
  <div class="section-label">Riwayat</div>
  <h2 class="section-title">Pengalaman Kerja<br>& Organisasi</h2>
  <div class="experience-list">

    <div class="exp-item">
      <div class="exp-date">Jan 2025 –<br>Sekarang</div>
      <div class="exp-content">
        <span class="exp-tag">Organisasi</span>
        <div class="exp-title">Wakil Ketua II</div>
        <div class="exp-org">PMII Komfaka – Cabang Ciputat</div>
        <div class="exp-desc"><ul>
          <li>Pengambilan keputusan strategis dan koordinasi antar bidang organisasi nasional</li>
          <li>Memimpin rapat koordinasi dan menyusun laporan program kepada pengurus cabang</li>
          <li>Mengawasi pelaksanaan program kerja di salah satu cabang PMII paling aktif di Indonesia</li>
        </ul></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="exp-item">
      <div class="exp-date">Sep – Des 2024</div>
      <div class="exp-content">
        <span class="exp-tag">Magang Pemerintah</span>
        <div class="exp-title">Pekerja Sosial (Magang)</div>
        <div class="exp-org">Pusat Sejarah TNI – Museum Satria Mandala</div>
        <div class="exp-desc"><ul>
          <li>Pengelolaan dokumen, data, dan administrasi institusi negara secara sistematis</li>
          <li>Koordinasi dengan staf dalam penyusunan dan pengarsipan dokumen resmi</li>
          <li>Memastikan akurasi dan kelengkapan data yang digunakan institusi</li>
        </ul></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="exp-item">
      <div class="exp-date">Mar 2024 –<br>Jan 2025</div>
      <div class="exp-content">
        <span class="exp-tag">Organisasi</span>
        <div class="exp-title">Kepala Departemen Kemahasiswaan</div>
        <div class="exp-org">HMPS Sejarah dan Peradaban Islam, UIN Jakarta</div>
        <div class="exp-desc"><ul>
          <li>Koordinasi kegiatan kemahasiswaan dan program pengembangan mahasiswa tingkat prodi</li>
          <li>Advokasi kepentingan mahasiswa kepada pihak akademik dan birokrasi kampus</li>
          <li>Membangun komunikasi formal antara mahasiswa, dosen, dan pihak fakultas</li>
        </ul></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="exp-item">
      <div class="exp-date">Jan 2024 –<br>Mei 2025</div>
      <div class="exp-content">
        <span class="exp-tag">Organisasi</span>
        <div class="exp-title">Kepala Bidang Sosial Budaya dan Keagamaan</div>
        <div class="exp-org">Keluarga Mahasiswa Islam Karawang (KMIK) Jakarta</div>
        <div class="exp-desc"><ul>
          <li>Merancang dan menjalankan program sosial kemasyarakatan dan pelestarian budaya daerah</li>
          <li>Koordinasi lintas bidang dalam pelaksanaan program kerja tahunan organisasi</li>
        </ul></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="exp-item">
      <div class="exp-date">Mar 2020 –<br>Jan 2021</div>
      <div class="exp-content">
        <span class="exp-tag">Kerja</span>
        <div class="exp-title">Surveyor / Enumerator</div>
        <div class="exp-org">PT. Pusat Data Riset</div>
        <div class="exp-desc"><ul>
          <li>Pengumpulan data lapangan melalui wawancara terstruktur untuk kebutuhan sensus</li>
          <li>Memastikan akurasi, kelengkapan, dan standar pelaporan data hasil survei</li>
        </ul></div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<!-- KEMAMPUAN -->
<section id="kemampuan">
  <div class="section-label">Kompetensi</div>
  <h2 class="section-title">Kemampuan &<br>Bahasa</h2>
  <div class="skills-wrap">
    <div>
      <div class="skill-group-title">Kemampuan Profesional</div>
      <div class="skill-list">
        <div class="skill-row">
          <div class="skill-name">Administrasi & Dokumentasi <span>Mahir</span></div>
          <div class="skill-bar"><div class="skill-fill" data-w="85"></div></div>

<script>
  // Scroll animations
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
      if (e.isIntersecting) {
        e.target.classList.add('visible');
        // Animate skill bars
        e.target.querySelectorAll('.skill-fill').forEach(bar => {
          bar.style.width = bar.dataset.w + '%';
        });
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.15 });

  document.querySelectorAll('section').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

  // Also trigger skill bars on section visible
  const skillObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
      if (e.isIntersecting) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.skill-fill').forEach(bar => {
          bar.style.width = bar.dataset.w + '%';
        });
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.3 });
  const skillSection = document.getElementById('kemampuan');
  if (skillSection) skillObserver.observe(skillSection);
</script>
